exposure: Left-sided valvular stenosis (aortic stenosis or mitral stenosis)
outcome: Composite adverse neonatal events (premature birth, low birth weight)
cohort: Pregnant women with confirmed left-sided valvular stenosis and a propensity score matched control group, whose data was retrospectively retrieved from the Chang Gung Research Database.
finding: Pregnant women with left-sided valvular stenosis had more comorbidities and medication use during pregnancy and were more likely to give birth to premature babies with low birth weight and poor vitality compared to controls.
mod_finding: The left-sided valvular stenosis group had a higher cesarean section rate, and cesarean section, along with general anesthesia, was identified as a significant factor associated with increased risks of composite adverse neonatal events.
